summary: Verified Duolingo-style pressed-state visual fix. Held mouse-down on each target button and read computed styles via getComputedStyle. All 5 targeted buttons show border-bottom-width shrinking from 4px→2px (not 0) and transform translateY(2px) while pressed — matching the expected Duolingo depth illusion. Also ran regression checks: task creation, name onboarding, city selection, prayer XP toggle, streak-only-on-complete, and Friday-only weekly task visibility.

city-makkah.result: PASS (btn-3d class applies active:border-b-2 active:translate-y-[2px] globally)

dismiss-new-day-btn.note: Not shown on fresh install (no previous-day data). Inline classes verified in code: active:border-b-2 active:translate-y-[2px]. Not runtime-verified this session.

regression_results.friday-only-task-hidden-on-non-friday: PASS (dow=2 Tue, task hidden as expected)

action_items: Optional: runtime-verify dismiss-new-day-btn by seeding a previous-day localStorage entry; code inspection confirms it uses the same active:border-b-2 active:translate-y-[2px] classes.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css .btn-3d now applies active:translate-y-[2px] active:border-b-2 globally — good single source of truth. Some buttons duplicate these classes inline (e.g. floating-add-btn); harmless but redundant.
No hard-coded URLs; REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL used correctly.
All 5 target buttons carry data-testid and are testable.
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage seeding of salah_first_user + salah_first_location to skip onboarding for the prayer XP regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Visual pressed-state fix verified via getComputedStyle on mouse-down. Use press-hold-then-move-away-and-release pattern to sample :active styles without triggering navigation on submit-style buttons. Prayer toggle testid is toggle-prayer-{key}, not prayer-{key}.
